My plot here in Manyara is 1.69 hectares of maize, and like most of my neighbors I intercrop with beans to spread the risk if the rains are poor. I have some schooling but fertilizer is expensive and the voucher program has been unreliable, so I will only buy a small amount of DAP for planting and rely mostly on the manure from my few cattle. I cannot afford irrigation or much pesticide, and I will use mostly family labor, hiring a few people only for weeding when the maize is knee-high.
